The AI story everyone's watching: 10 AI Agents Every Small Business Should Use Now

What's actually happening: Small businesses' adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) for their specific needs has transitioned from being hyped to actually useful.

The contrarian take: the tools getting all the hype aren't the ones creating value. Fancy features ≠ adoption. Cool demos ≠ ROI.

https://www.forbes.com/sites/terdawn-deboe/2026/03/27/10-ai-agents-for-small-business-that-give-immediate-relief

The AI adoption trap:

Buying 5 tools and using none consistently.

The fix: pick ONE task, automate it, measure the hours saved. Repeat.

Consistency beats tool count every time.
